resources.string: The server records the whole chat. Later a thief takes User 2\'s phone with everything in it. Can the thief read what was recorded?
Three rounds done, the server kept a copy of every message
Steal the phone and decrypt the recording
Not readable: its key was deleted right after use
Every message key is thrown away once used, and the chain only moves forward. The current state cannot go back to older keys.
The thief copies User 2\'s session and keeps listening to the server. New Diffie-Hellman keys in every reply push the thief out again.
The thief has a full copy of User 2\'s session
A reply to User 1, the stolen copy cannot read it
Try: copy the session, let User 1 send twice, let User 2 reply, then let User 1 send again
Networks lose and reorder messages, and an attacker can resend or change them. The ratchet keeps keys for skipped messages and checks every message before trusting it.
